target: H iff d=aleph_1 in ZFC; relative independence assuming Con(ZFC).

dependencies.claim: Historical independence resolution was already credited to Hinkkanen (unpublished).
dependencies.role: Credit and target provenance, not a recovered proof.

dependencies.claim: Strict maximum-modulus ratio cofinality has least size d; the full omega_1 chain exists iff d=aleph_1.
dependencies.role: Authored majorant, one-step-shift all-real-radii estimate, countable upper bound and omega_1 recursion. No formula attribution or novelty claim.

dependencies.claim: Con(ZFC) implies Con(ZFC+CH), giving d=aleph_1 and hence H.
dependencies.source: Gödel (1939), Theorems 7–10 and final formalization paragraph, pp.223–224; established constructibility metatheorem.
dependencies.role: Positive relative-consistency input; original paper is a sketch.

dependencies.claim: A CH ground model admits a cardinal-preserving extension with c=d=aleph_2, hence not H.
dependencies.source: Blass–Shelah (1987), Theorem 5.2(a),(d), p.238; section 5 setup/preservation, pp.234–235.
dependencies.role: Published negative consistency theorem; relies on standard proper-forcing iteration results.
